# Profile settings

<div class="gen-note">Generated from the APS 3.0 source code: every name, pin, default and description below is read from the plugin itself, so it matches what you see in the editor.</div>

Everything an AI perceives, and how sharply, is set on its **Perception Profile** (a Data Asset). These are all of its settings, in the order and groups of its Details panel. A new profile works as it is: every setting has a working default.

## Composition
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-parent-profile" data-search="Parent Profile" data-text="Inherit every setting from this profile, keeping only the fields changed here. A field counts as changed when it differs from the class default — exactly the fields the Details panel marks with a revert-to-default arrow. Leave a field alone and it tracks the parent; edit it and it is yours. Start a "><div class="set-head"><b>Parent Profile</b><span class="pin object"><i></i><small>Perception Profile</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>None</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ParentProfile</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Inherit every setting from this profile, keeping only the fields changed here.</p><p>A field counts as changed when it differs from the class default — exactly the fields the Details panel marks with a revert-to-default arrow. Leave a field alone and it tracks the parent; edit it and it is yours.</p><p>Start a child from a NEW profile rather than a duplicate of the parent. A duplicate carries every one of the parent&#x27;s tuned values as changed fields, so it would inherit nothing and drift the moment the parent moves on.</p><p>To pin a value that happens to equal the class default, put it in Overrides below — that list is read after inheritance and always wins.</p><p>Composition is resolved once, when an agent starts or swaps profiles, into a private copy owned by that agent. Editing the parent therefore affects agents that spawn afterwards, not ones already running.</p><p>Use Show Composition to see exactly which fields are inherited.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-overrides" data-search="Overrides" data-text="Extra changes stamped on after inheritance is resolved. Rarely needed on an asset — editing the field directly is the normal way to override one. This exists for values a Blueprint wants to compute, and it is the same list the component uses for per-agent tweaks."><div class="set-head"><b>Overrides</b><span class="pin struct container"><i></i><small>Array of APSProfile Override</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>Overrides</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Extra changes stamped on after inheritance is resolved.</p><p>Rarely needed on an asset — editing the field directly is the normal way to override one. This exists for values a Blueprint wants to compute, and it is the same list the component uses for per-agent tweaks.</p></div></div></div>

All three default to 1, meaning stance changes nothing until you opt in — adding "><div class="set-head"><b>Min Visible Points Standing</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>MinVisiblePoints_Standing</code></span><span>1 to 16</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Minimum number of visible sample points required before a target registers, per stance. Splinter Cell&#x27;s rule: a crouched target behind cover should need more of itself exposed than a standing one before the AI commits.</p><p>All three default to 1, meaning stance changes nothing until you opt in — adding an APS Target Component must never silently make a character harder to see. ## Performance
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-async-vision-traces" data-search="Async Vision Traces" data-text="Issue vision&#x27;s visibility traces asynchronously, reading the results on the next evaluation instead of blocking on them. Vision is the single largest trace cost in the system, and this moves it off the game thread. The trade is that exposure describes where the target was one evaluation ago — about "><div class="set-head"><b>Async Vision Traces</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bAsyncVisionTraces</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Issue vision&#x27;s visibility traces asynchronously, reading the results on the next evaluation instead of blocking on them.</p><p>Vision is the single largest trace cost in the system, and this moves it off the game thread. The trade is that exposure describes where the target was one evaluation ago — about 0.15 s at default settings — so a target crossing cover quickly is judged a fraction late.</p><p>Off by default: it is a performance choice with a behavioural cost, and that is the project&#x27;s call rather than a default anyone should inherit. Per-surface transmission always stays synchronous, since partial results across frames cannot express it correctly.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-base-update-interval" data-search="Base Update Interval" data-text="Base perception tick interval (seconds). Lower = more reactive, higher CPU cost."><div class="set-head"><b>Base Update Interval</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.1</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>BaseUpdateInterval</code></span><span>0.016 to 2</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Base perception tick interval (seconds). Lower = more reactive, higher CPU cost.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-maintenance-interval" data-search="Maintenance Interval" data-text="How often the ledger runs maintenance — expire old records, compact (seconds)."><div class="set-head"><b>Maintenance Interval</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.5</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>MaintenanceInterval</code></span><span>0.1 to 5</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How often the ledger runs maintenance — expire old records, compact (seconds).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-max-tracked-targets" data-search="Max Tracked Targets" data-text="Maximum number of targets tracked simultaneously."><div class="set-head"><b>Max Tracked Targets</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>16</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>MaxTrackedTargets</code></span><span>1 to 32</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Maximum number of targets tracked simultaneously.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-distance-tick-throttling" data-search="Distance Tick Throttling" data-text="Stop dispatching a tick every frame for agents that are very far from the camera (LOD tier 3 and 4 — beyond 15 km). Without this the component still receives a full tick every frame at those distances purely to accumulate time and return early. The perception rate itself does not change: the accumul"><div class="set-head"><b>Distance Tick Throttling</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>On</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bDistanceTickThrottling</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Stop dispatching a tick every frame for agents that are very far from the camera (LOD tier 3 and 4 — beyond 15 km).</p><p>Without this the component still receives a full tick every frame at those distances purely to accumulate time and return early. The perception rate itself does not change: the accumulator is fed the real elapsed time either way, so decay and lifecycle timing are identical. Tiers 0-2 are untouched, which is what keeps debug drawing smooth on any agent you can actually see.</p><p>Turn off if you drive LOD tiers yourself and want every agent ticking at frame rate regardless of distance.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-sort-weight-confidence" data-search="Sort Weight Confidence" data-text="Sort score weight: confidence."><div class="set-head"><b>Sort ### Crowd
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-enable-statistical-tier" data-search="Enable Statistical Tier" data-text="Let very distant agents perceive statistically instead of geometrically. Above the tier below, an agent stops tracing entirely. Detection becomes a probability rolled against distance, light and movement — no line of sight, no sample points, no cone sweep. It costs a few multiplies per candidate ins"><div class="set-head"><b>Enable Statistical Tier</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bEnableStatisticalTier</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Let very distant agents perceive statistically instead of geometrically.</p><p>Above the tier below, an agent stops tracing entirely. Detection becomes a probability rolled against distance, light and movement — no line of sight, no sample points, no cone sweep. It costs a few multiplies per candidate instead of a dozen traces, which is what makes a crowd of civilians into plausible witnesses rather than scenery.</p><p>They are NOT blind and they are NOT accurate. An agent in this tier will occasionally notice someone it has no line of sight to, and occasionally miss someone standing in front of it. That is the trade, and it only holds up at a distance where nobody is watching closely enough to tell.</p><p>Off by default: geometric perception is what this plugin is for, and an approximation should never be something a project inherits by accident.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-statistical-tier-threshold" data-search="Statistical Tier Threshold" data-text="LOD tier at or above which statistical perception replaces the real thing. 3 is roughly 15 km from the nearest viewer at default significance."><div class="set-head"><b>Statistical Tier Threshold</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>3</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>StatisticalTierThreshold</code></span><span>1 to 4</span><span class="when">only when Enable Statistical Tier is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>LOD tier at or above which statistical perception replaces the real thing. 3 is roughly 15 km from the nearest viewer at default significance.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-statistical-detection-rate" data-search="Statistical Detection Rate" data-text="Chance per second of noticing an ideally-placed target — close, lit, moving. Everything else scales this down."><div class="set-head"><b>Statistical Detection Rate</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>1</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>StatisticalDetectionRate</code></span><span>0 to 10</span><span class="when">only when Enable Statistical Tier is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Chance per second of noticing an ideally-placed target — close, lit, moving. Everything else scales this down.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-statistical-detection-confidence" data-search="Statistical Detection Confidence" data-text="Confidence granted when a statistical detection lands. Deliberately modest: a distant agent that half-noticed something should be suspicious, not certain."><div class="set-head"><b>Statistical Detection Confidence</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.5</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>StatisticalDetectionConfidence</code></span><span>0 to 1</span><span class="when">only when Enable Statistical Tier is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Confidence granted when a statistical detection lands. Deliberately modest: a distant agent that half-noticed something should be suspicious, not certain.</p></div></div></div>

Prevents premature adaptation."><div class="set-head"><b>Min Engagements Required</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>3</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>MinEngagementsRequired</code></span><span>1 to 20</span><span class="when">only when Enable Player Behavior Model is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Minimum engagements before AI adapts. Prevents premature adaptation.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-player-crouch-speed-threshold" data-search="Player Crouch Speed Threshold" data-text="Speed below which player is considered crouching (cm/s)."><div class="set-head"><b>Player Crouch Speed Threshold</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>120</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>PlayerCrouchSpeedThreshold</code></span><span>at least 10</span><span class="when">only when Enable Player Behavior Model is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Speed below which player is considered crouching (cm/s).</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-player-sprint-speed-threshold" data-search="Player Sprint Speed Threshold" data-text="Speed above which player is considered sprinting (cm/s)."><div class="set-head"><b>Player Sprint Speed Threshold</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>500</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>PlayerSprintSpeedThreshold</code></span><span>at least 100</span><span class="when">only when Enable Player Behavior Model is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Speed above which player is considered sprinting (cm/s).</p></div></div></div>

## Fairness
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-first-spot-reaction-time" data-search="First Spot Reaction Time" data-text="Seconds the AI must hold a target before confidence begins accumulating, on FIRST acquisition only. This is reaction time: it gives the player a beat to break line of sight after stepping into view. 0 = instant."><div class="set-head"><b>First Spot Reaction Time</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>FirstSpotReactionTime</code></span><span>0 to 5</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds the AI must hold a target before confidence begins accumulating, on FIRST acquisition only. This is reaction time: it gives the player a beat to break line of sight after stepping into view. 0 = instant.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-telegraph-threshold" data-search="Telegraph Threshold" data-text="Confidence at which OnAITelegraph fires — a hook to play a &quot;huh?&quot; bark or head-turn BEFORE the AI commits to full alert, so detection is readable. Should sit between SuspectThreshold and DetectThreshold."><div class="set-head"><b>Telegraph Threshold</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.25</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>TelegraphThreshold</code></span><span>0 to 1</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Confidence at which OnAITelegraph fires — a hook to play a &quot;huh?&quot; bark or head-turn BEFORE the AI commits to full alert, so detection is readable. Should sit between SuspectThreshold and DetectThreshold.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-offscreen-hearing-penalty" data-search="Offscreen Hearing Penalty" data-text="Reduce hearing sensitivity while this AI is off every player&#x27;s screen. Stops unseen AI reacting to noise the player never saw them hear."><div class="set-head"><b>Offscreen Hearing Penalty</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bOffscreenHearingPenalty</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Reduce hearing sensitivity while this AI is off every player&#x27;s screen. Stops unseen AI reacting to noise the player never saw them hear.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-offscreen-hearing-multiplier" data-search="Offscreen Hearing Multiplier" data-text="Hearing multiplier applied while off-screen [0..1]."><div class="set-head"><b>Offscreen Hearing Multiplier</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.75</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>OffscreenHearingMultiplier</code></span><span>0 to 1</span><span class="when">only when Offscreen Hearing Penalty is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Hearing multiplier applied while off-screen [0..1].</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-respect-never-search-zones" data-search="Respect Never Search Zones" data-text="Honour designer-flagged no-search zones registered on the APS subsystem. A target whose last known position falls inside one is never pursued there, guaranteeing the player safe rooms."><div class="set-head"><b>Respect Never Search Zones</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>On</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bRespectNeverSearchZones</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Honour designer-flagged no-search zones registered on the APS subsystem. A target whose last known position falls inside one is never pursued there, guaranteeing the player safe rooms.</p></div></div></div>

## Replication
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="s-replicate-perception-state" data-search="Replicate Perception State" data-text="Replicate a compact per-target perception summary to clients so client-side detection meters, HUD and spectator tools work without custom plumbing. Perception itself stays server-authoritative."><div class="set-head"><b>Replicate Perception State</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>Off</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bReplicatePerceptionState</code></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Replicate a compact per-target perception summary to clients so client-side detection meters, HUD and spectator tools work without custom plumbing. Perception itself stays server-authoritative.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-max-replicated-targets" data-search="Max Replicated Targets" data-text="Maximum targets included in the replicated summary. Keep small — this is bandwidth on every AI."><div class="set-head"><b>Max Replicated Targets</b><span class="pin int"><i></i><small>Integer</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>3</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>MaxReplicatedTargets</code></span><span>1 to 8</span><span class="when">only when Replicate Perception State is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Maximum targets included in the replicated summary. Keep small — this is bandwidth on every AI.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-replication-interval" data-search="Replication Interval" data-text="Seconds between replicated state refreshes."><div class="set-head"><b>Replication Interval</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.25</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ReplicationInterval</code></span><span>0.05 to 2</span><span class="when">only when Replicate Perception State is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds between replicated state refreshes.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-use-replication-relevance" data-search="Use Replication Relevance" data-text="Only publish targets a viewer could plausibly care about. Without this every AI publishes its whole shortlist to every client, and the bandwidth scales with agents times targets whether or not anyone can see the outcome. Relevance is judged against the nearest local viewer, so a guard tracking someo"><div class="set-head"><b>Use Replication Relevance</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>On</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bUseReplicationRelevance</code></span><span class="when">only when Replicate Perception State is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Only publish targets a viewer could plausibly care about.</p><p>Without this every AI publishes its whole shortlist to every client, and the bandwidth scales with agents times targets whether or not anyone can see the outcome. Relevance is judged against the nearest local viewer, so a guard tracking someone on the far side of the map stops paying for it.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-replication-relevance-range" data-search="Replication Relevance Range" data-text="Beyond this from every viewer, a target is dropped from the summary (cm). 0 disables the distance test and keeps only the confidence one."><div class="set-head"><b>Replication Relevance Range</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>15000</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ReplicationRelevanceRange</code></span><span>at least 0</span><span class="when">only when Use Replication Relevance is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Beyond this from every viewer, a target is dropped from the summary (cm). 0 disables the distance test and keeps only the confidence one.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-replication-min-confidence" data-search="Replication Min Confidence" data-text="Below this confidence a target is not worth the bandwidth. A detection meter that has barely flickered is not something a client needs told about."><div class="set-head"><b>Replication Min Confidence</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.1</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ReplicationMinConfidence</code></span><span>0 to 1</span><span class="when">only when Use Replication Relevance is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Below this confidence a target is not worth the bandwidth. A detection meter that has barely flickered is not something a client needs told about.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-skip-unchanged-replication" data-search="Skip Unchanged Replication" data-text="Skip the update entirely when nothing meaningfully changed. The summary is rebuilt on a timer regardless of whether belief moved, and writing an identical array still dirties the property and sends it. This compares against what was last published and stays quiet when the difference is below the thr"><div class="set-head"><b>Skip Unchanged Replication</b><span class="pin bool"><i></i><small>Boolean</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>On</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>bSkipUnchangedReplication</code></span><span class="when">only when Replicate Perception State is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Skip the update entirely when nothing meaningfully changed.</p><p>The summary is rebuilt on a timer regardless of whether belief moved, and writing an identical array still dirties the property and sends it. This compares against what was last published and stays quiet when the difference is below the threshold below.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="s-replication-confidence-delta" data-search="Replication Confidence Delta" data-text="How much confidence must move before it is worth sending."><div class="set-head"><b>Replication Confidence Delta</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0.02</b></span><span title="The name Overrides, Set Profile Number and aps.Tune take">Override name <code>ReplicationConfidenceDelta</code></span><span>0 to 0.5</span><span class="when">only when Skip Unchanged Replication is on</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>How much confidence must move before it is worth sending.</p></div></div></div>
